'''Star Tours Flight 1009''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]], [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] and [[Storinal]]. On the morning of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was on time and stationed at Gate 1D where it was set to arrive at 0735 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 0830.
